unspecified.behavior: For a query with free text and an exclusion (e.g. 'cats -path:Work'), resolveAppTarget and resolveVideoTarget now return usable params carrying both search and exclude keys, where before they returned unsupported_part.

scores.reason: Every caller checks the member target first or ORs the two results (VideoAppHeader.tsx:15, useVideoApp.ts:172, readingAppTarget.ts:39, useNotesTarget.ts:230-231), so the user sees no difference.

Only a query with free text and an exclusion triggers it, and the user sees nothing different. Every caller (useVideoApp.ts:226, useNotesTarget.ts:84, and Reading through its member resolver) tries resolveMemberTarget first, and a query with free text always becomes a member target (memberTarget.ts:89), so the new direct params with search and exclude keys are never sent. The change only alters the result of a usability check whose outcome was already usable.

unspecified.behavior: resolveVideoTarget calls hasImpossibleConditions(parsed) without folder.file_type, while resolveAppTarget passes it.

scores.reason: Video's separate excluded-kind and kinds checks give the same empty result for a fixed file_type, so the user sees nothing different.

It applies when a Video target query excludes a kind and the folder has a fixed file_type. The user sees no difference: resolveVideoTarget re-resolves kinds with folder.file_type at videoAppTarget.ts:57-61 and returns empty whenever the fixed kind is not video or video is excluded, so leaving out the argument at line 54 never changes the result.
